analysis_scope.idp_format_policy: Primary R1/R2 fit uses the inherited all-nonmock primary_r1_r4 catalog; non-IDP-only R1/R2 results are required as a sensitivity analysis, matching the original V3 contract.
analysis_scope.rounds_3_to_6: frozen at deployed values; never fit in V5

C0_DEPLOYED.definition: Exact deployed PICK_BASE. Baseline only; never refit.

C1_R1_GLOBAL_RESCALE.definition: Multiply all three deployed R1 tier values by one development-fit scalar k1. R2-R6 remain deployed.

C2_R1_R2_ROUND_RESCALE.definition: Apply separate development-fit scalars to deployed R1 and R2 tier values. R3-R6 remain deployed.

C3_R1_R2_LOW_PARAMETER_TIER_CURVE.constraint: 0 <= mid_penalty <= late_penalty; generated R1/R2 cells must be positive and non-increasing with later draft slot.
C3_R1_R2_LOW_PARAMETER_TIER_CURVE.definition: value(round,tier) = A * exp(-b*I(round==2) - tier_penalty[tier]); early penalty=0. R3-R6 remain deployed.

candidate_fit.objective: Equal-cell macro mean absolute error on O2 three_year_player_equivalent_fv across the six R1/R2 production cells, with each draft class contributing equal total weight.
candidate_fit.optimizer_rule: Use deterministic bounded optimization. If multiple parameter vectors are numerically tied within 1e-9 objective value, choose lexicographically smallest rounded parameter vector.

fit_weighting.league_market_weight: Each draft class contributes equal total weight. Within class and eligible depth, leagues are equally weighted.
fit_weighting.player_clustering: Outcome loss and uncertainty must collapse/cluster repeated selections by stable player identity within draft class before computing inferential uncertainty.
fit_weighting.player_outcome_independence: Repeated league selections of the same player are not independent outcome observations.

forbidden: reading historical NFL player outcomes before the exact source/identity catalog gate passes
using KTC or any market value as a V5 fit target, loss, weight, or validation target
changing Market Value or Team Utility
lowering V3/V4 historical source thresholds retroactively
relabeling V3 or V4 as successful studies
adding/removing candidate families after validation is read
manual source inclusions after outcomes are observed

frozen_deployed_baseline.v5_year_discount_policy: YEAR_DISCOUNT is not fit or changed in V5. Historical realized outcomes identify the PICK_BASE R1/R2 scale; future-year discount remains frozen for a separate question.

historical_outcome_contract.availability_gate: Each primary class must have nonempty outcome data for draft_year through draft_year+2. Missing required seasons exclude the class before the development/validation split; all feasibility gates are then rechecked.
historical_outcome_contract.scoring_source: Current reviewed league scoring logic from research/roster-economics/historical_weekly_points_pipeline.py

motivation.interpretation: The external-market bridge diagnostic motivates the R1/R2 research question only. KTC/market values are not an outcome, fit target, weight, validation target, or production calibration source in V5.

phase2_source_catalog_rule.v3_seed: Use only V3 league_audit rows with positive_rookie_scope_contamination=false and scope.primary_r1_r4=true.
phase2_source_catalog_rule.v4_expansion: Use only V4 new_source_evidence.rows with positive_contamination=false and primary_r1_r4=true.

O1_shape.definition: Score the rookie's first three NFL seasons under league scoring. Replacement PPG is full-NFL season PPG at the frozen positional rank among players with at least 3 games. Annual surplus=max(0, season_total - replacement_ppg*scheduled_games). Sum years 1-3.
O1_shape.name: three_year_replacement_adjusted_football_utility
O1_shape.use: shape robustness only; raw O1 is not FV

O2_scale.aggregation: arithmetic mean of years 1-3 annual FV equivalents
O2_scale.name: three_year_player_equivalent_fv

question: Using the already-audited clean historical 12-team Superflex/2QB rookie-draft source population, do realized first-three-season player-equivalent Fundamental Values support a better R1/R2 absolute scale and tier shape than the deployed pick table?

robustness.H4: first four NFL seasons where fully mature
robustness.bootstrap_unit: stable player identity clustered within draft class; repeated selections of the same player are not independent observations

eligibility_gates: validation macro MAE improvement vs C0 >= 5%
candidate must improve O2 macro MAE vs C0 in BOTH 2022 and 2023 validation classes
O1 normalized-shape error regression vs C0 <= 2%
H2 O2 macro-MAE regression vs candidate H3 primary horizon <= 2% relative
mature H4 O2 macro-MAE regression vs candidate H3 primary horizon <= 2% relative
all six fitted R1/R2 production cells positive
after splicing onto untouched R3-R6, all 18 production cells remain monotone non-increasing with later draft slot
no forbidden data read before locked validation scoring
selection.primary_metric: Locked-validation equal-cell macro MAE on O2 across the six R1/R2 production cells.
selection.winner_rule: Lowest locked-validation O2 macro MAE among eligible candidates; if within 1% relative MAE, choose fewer effective fitted degrees of freedom in order C1, C2, C3.

source_contract.why_r4_complete_is_used: The inherited clean primary_r1_r4 cohort is the audited source population. V5 analyzes only its first 24 actual slots and does not reopen the source search.

source_sufficiency.deep_round_gates: Not applicable to the new V5 estimand because R3-R6 are explicitly outside the V5 fitting scope and remain production-frozen.

stage_gates.after_outcome_harvest: Fit candidates on 2018-2021 development only, then score locked 2022-2023 exactly once.
stage_gates.after_selection: Freeze results. Any production change requires a separate explicit human review and deployment workflow.
stage_gates.after_source_catalog_freeze: Require exact source count/by-year reproduction, actual-slot completeness for slots 1-24, no positive rookie-scope contamination, duplicate checks, and >=95% identity resolution. Only then may the separate outcome-harvest workflow run.
stage_gates.after_this_freeze: Build and freeze the exact 378-draft R1/R2 source catalog and identity map only. Do not read historical NFL outcomes yet.
